description:
Activate Ramos by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast to gain sunburst.
Activate Filigree Sages by paying {2}{U}, untapping Solar Array.
Activate Drafna by paying {1}{U}, returning Ramos from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Ramos by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Solar Array triggers, giving Ramos sunburst, which will cause it to enter the battlefield with five +1/+1 counters.
Repeat.
